description: Define the design truth for a brand, product, or system. Turn it into tokens, guidance, and production outputs while people, automations, and AI contribute through one reviewable workflow. Use TokenLab in ChatGPT and Codex to explore workspaces, projects, libraries, modes, aliases, and releases, resolve tokens for implementation, and prepare governed changes on branches for human review.

defaultPrompt: Audit a TokenLab system: trace aliases, compare semantic tokens across Light and Dark modes, and identify inconsistencies.
Create a TokenLab system with primitives, semantic color, typography and spacing tokens, Light/Dark modes, and aliases.
Update a TokenLab system safely on a branch, review the diff, and submit it for human approval without merging.
